clues.it: Elena era nella 2ª colonna e nella 1ª riga, ma non era accanto a una grata.
clues.en: Elena was in the 2nd column and in the 1st row, but was not beside a floor grate.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 1ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e a nord di Fabio.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 1st column, in the 2nd row and north of Fabio.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 7ª colonna e a ovest di Rosa.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 7th column and west of Rosa.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era nella 5ª colonna, accanto a una vasca idroponica e a nord di Ugo.
clues.en: Dario was in the 5th column, beside a hydroponic tank and north of Ugo.

clues.it: Tea era nella stessa stanza di Sergio.
clues.en: Tea was in the same room as Sergio.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 3ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e in Serra.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 3rd column, in the 7th row and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a una consolle e a una grata.
clues.en: Carla was beside a console and a floor grate.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 9ª colonna e accanto a un fascio di cavi, ma non era accanto a una vasca idroponica.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 9th column and beside a cable bundle, but was not beside a hydroponic tank.

clues.it: Nino era nella 8ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Bruno.
clues.en: Nino was in the 8th column and in the same room as Bruno.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
